findings.consequence: The flow presents every execution as a video download with retries, but subtitle-only tasks enter the same worker, bypass video download and publication retries, and stop after a failure without retrying.
findings.correction: Add the subtitle-only branch and its no-retry outcome, or explicitly restrict the diagram's entry to normal video-download tasks.

findings.consequence: The terminal nodes omit cleanup and storage-close failures: cancellation cleanup can leave the task failed, a storage-close failure can turn a pause into failure, and completed work can retain a cleanup warning.
findings.correction: Document these failure and warning outcomes alongside the affected terminal paths.

limitations: Read-only semantic review; application code and tests were not executed, and no test execution evidence was supplied.
The diagram's stated scope excludes detailed site extraction and subsequent subtitle processing.
